assumptions.site_air: forecast + per-farm bias (wind σ 0.35 m/s, temp σ 0.8 °C, RH σ 4 %) + slow drift + 22 % turbulence; wind from ~300° (NW) ± 25° per farm

assumptions.drift: deposit shifted downwind by release height x wind / 3 m/s (downwash); 1.5 % per m/s stays airborne
assumptions.crew: drive x 0.9-1.25, setup 15 ± 4 min, refill and swap 2-6 min (3 planned)
assumptions.spraylog: u-blox M8N + GAGAN: GPS bias random walk σ≈1.2 m + 0.5 m jitter; flow meter jug-calibrated to -0.5 % with 3 % reading noise
